Messages.Author: 2wayspeaker
Messages.Body:
From what I gather from that topic, regarding weapons:
Optional Maneuver -> you have to use the weapon (zip gun, magnum)
Optional press/strike/prevent -> no requirement on striking with the weapon (talbots chainsaw, sword of judgment) unless otherwise stated (ak-47)

Is this correct or could I still refuse to strike at all if I use a gun maneuver?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> 2wayspeaker wrote:
> Is this correct or could I still refuse to strike at all if I use a gun maneuver?
>
You can't voluntarily decline to strike, unless you have card text permitting that. e.g.  Putrefaction , although maneuvering with the gun has committed you to choosing the strike anyway. And obviously certain things (Immortal Grapple) can render your strike impossible leaving you stuck, but that's not voluntary either.

Basically, if you maneuver with the gun, you have to try to strike with it.
